component: News URL XPCOM removal and generic receiver contracts

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The factory routes the five news-related scheme literals through generic nsMsgMailNewsUrl construction. Callers switch from nsINntpUrl QI to IsNewsScheme, and the JS channel parses the URI spec itself. The generic interface map omits the removed message/I18N URL interfaces and its folder accessor is not implemented; tests change that expectation. This is an intentional API contract change, not proof of protocol, ABI or security equivalence. Later accepted POP grouping and stricter content-policy checks are separate phases.
title: Generic news URLs replace typed XPCOM getters with scheme-based callers
